background.value: White background required; photo must be in color

cross_verification.note_en: Confirmed directly via the Embassy of the Republic of Mozambique in Washington, D.C. (usa.embamoc.gov.mz), an official Mozambican government diplomatic mission page: 'Submit two passport size photographs (passport photos must be in color and with a white background).' No dimensions in mm/inches, head-height, expression, glasses, or headwear policy are published on this page. Background='White' matches the current DB value exactly, so no db_conflict is logged. SENAMI (senami.gov.mz), Mozambique's domestic migration authority, publishes a more detailed PDF but could not be reached directly during this pass (see mz-passport.json note) — so no additional fields from that document were added here.
